name: RNA and genomic-signal coordinate windows
description: Read selected deposited signal tracks against the exact reference feature frame and calculate stated local contrasts; keep processed tracks distinct from raw-read reconstruction and transcript-processing evidence distinct from ordinary abundance.

capability_operations.operation: Retrieve selected study metadata and track files

inputs.selection: specific processed tracks and reference feature version

outputs.files: identified track/reference bytes and sample metadata

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

inputs.track: identified bedGraph/wig-like or explicit coordinate signal table
inputs.reference: exact accession/version, strand and coordinate convention

outputs.values: per-position/interval values and declared local summary
outputs.comparison: selected sample contrasts with reference and normalization provenance

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Reconstruct a new RNA profile from reads

inputs.reads: actual FASTQ files and sample designs

outputs.profile: processed coverage/ends/counts with normalization and uncertainty under that pipeline

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

repository_catalog_defined: public.ncbi.search/sequence and reference.neighborhood can provide selected source/reference context. The catalog defines generic reads.map, but that does not establish an RNA-seq/Rend-seq analysis pipeline or GEO acquisition adapter.
research_operations_performed: cellular/ylbF_probe_provenance.json and ylbF_rendseq_control_observations.json:76-file GSE108295 processed-track archive and exact reference table; selected cggR/gapA,glnR/glnA,rpoB,rnpB windows examined.
organism GcsR trace: GSE76522 metadata only; no read reprocessing.
capability_specifications_not_confirmed_: New RNA-seq/Rend-seq mapping, processing-site inference, differential analysis and formal replication statistics were not performed or established as registered tools.
author_experiments_are_source_evidence_o: RNA purification, sequencing, Northern assays and reporter measurements are author experiments/data generation.
availability.binding_limit: A repository catalog definition is confirmed source-code identity, not proof of caller enablement, service availability, installed dependencies or execution in this research. Research scripts are retained operations, not registered runtime tools.

limits: A processed end signal is not ordinary gene-expression abundance and its normalization is source-specific.
No window or reference remapping without explicit accession/coordinate correspondence.
Metadata-only access or an accession listing supplies no new biological signal.

observed_uses.execution_scope: Selected known windows, no raw realignment, new processing-site discovery or formal replication analysis.
